ex.en: The company issued a short statement in response to the complaints.
ex.zh: 公司针对这些投诉发表了一份简短声明。

words.note: in response to 是固定搭配，后接名词；动词 respond 也要接 to。

ex.en: The two countries signed a peace treaty after years of difficult talks.
ex.zh: 经过多年艰难谈判，两国签署了和平条约。

words.note: treaty 指国家间的正式条约，比 agreement 更正式。

ex.en: She faced her long illness with dignity and never complained in public.
ex.zh: 她从容面对久病，从不在公开场合抱怨。

words.note: dignity 常与 with 连用；形容词 dignified 意为庄重的。

ex.en: Rising costs are the biggest challenge facing small businesses this year.
ex.zh: 成本上升是今年小企业面临的最大挑战。

words.note: challenge 作动词直接跟宾语，不说 challenge against sb。

ex.en: The two rival companies have been competing for the same customers for years.
ex.zh: 这两家竞争公司多年来争夺同一批客户。

words.note: rival 可作名词、形容词和动词；rival sb 意为比得上某人。
